description: Create remote configuration — Creates a new remote in `rclone.conf`, mirroring `rclone config create`.

_async.description: Run the command asynchronously. Returns a job id immediately.

_group.description: Assign the request to a custom stats group.

name.description: Name of the new remote configuration.

opt.description: Optional JSON object controlling interactive behaviour (e.g. `obscure`, `continue`).

parameters.description: JSON object of configuration key/value pairs required for the remote.

type.description: Backend type identifier, such as `drive`, `s3`, or `dropbox`.

name: config_create
